name: TranslateBuff
summary: A browser extension that translates web pages and selected text, with a free trial and Pro plans billed at clear annual or multi-month totals.
description: TranslateBuff is an AI translation browser extension for full pages and selected text, with side-by-side reading and 20+ models on Pro. The footer names Junyun Limited.

pricing.details: Free trial (basic translation). Pro Annual 46 €/year (4 €/month equivalent, 2M tokens/month); Pro 2 Months 12 € every 2 months (6 €/month equivalent, 2.5M tokens/month); Pro 3 Years 54 € every 36 months (1 €/month equivalent, 1.5M tokens/month).
pricing.label: Freemium
